note: Attacker-controlled input bytes are copied into the fuzzer buffer before parsing.
The fuzzer hands the parser a bounded byte range from the copied input.
The lexer end pointer is derived from attacker-controlled size and defines the boundary for subsequent scans.
Three leading quotes dispatch the lexer into multiline-string mode.
The lexer chooses a 3-byte terminator pattern based on the next attacker-controlled byte.
Each loop iteration compares three bytes starting at lexer->pos, which can reach the exact end of the attacker-controlled buffer in an unterminated multiline string and read past it.
